person: Lan Tran is a 41-year-old pharmacy technician who came from Vietnam at nineteen. She works rotating shifts at a chain pharmacy and keeps the family's aid and benefit accounts on her phone. Her husband Hung was laid off from a warehouse in June 2026, and her own hours were cut in July. Her daughter Linh started at Marlow Ridge College this fall, and the aid still uses 2024 income. Lan reads official letters slowly, wants every step in plain words, and worries about any fee. She has paid an application helper before and got nothing useful.
stated_up_front: Hello. My husband lost his job in June and my hours went down in July. My daughter's college aid still uses old money, can you help me ask them to look again? Please tell me if anything costs money.

facts.truth: Linh Tran, first year at Marlow Ridge College, 2026-27 aid based on 2024 income.

facts.about: Deadline the college gave for special-circumstances requests

facts.truth: Laid off from the warehouse in June 2026. His wages before the layoff were 28,800 dollars, including paid vacation.
480 dollars a week for 26 weeks, 12,480 to the maximum. So his estimated 2026 income is 50,880.
Hours were cut in July 2026. Paid so far this year 21,450 dollars. Six pay periods left at 980 dollars each, 5,880, so her estimate is 27,330. It is on her pay stubs.
Linh worked at a bubble tea shop in summer. It ends every August, and it did in 2024 too.
Danny goes to Corrimore Institute and has his own award there. His deadline has passed. The family wants nothing for him.

facts.about: Other costs the family worries about
facts.truth: The college raised tuition for everyone. The family health insurance premium is 640 dollars a month. Neither is a change in the family's income.
An application helper emailed an offer of 695 dollars to do the aid request. A letter about 21,000 dollars of severance came to her address but is for another family.
Her mother lives with them and has no income.

unknowns: Whether the college counts unemployment benefits still to come in the 2026 estimate, and how.
What a special-circumstances request is called by the law, and what a dependency override is.
How many weeks of benefits Hung has left right now.
Whether the college can say no, and whether she can appeal.
Whose the 21,000 dollar severance letter is.
